2.t: This is an account of your Lord’s grace towards His servant, Zachariah,

3.t: when he called to his Lord secretly, saying,

4.t: ‘Lord, my bones have weakened and my hair is ashen grey, but never, Lord, have I ever prayed to You in vain:

5.t: I fear [what] my kinsmen [will do] when I am gone, for my wife is barren, so grant me a successor––a gift from You––

6.t: to be my heir and the heir of the family of Jacob. Lord, make him well pleasing [to You].’

7.t: ‘Zachariah, We bring you good news of a son whose name will be John––We have chosen this name for no one before him.’

8.t: He said, ‘Lord, how can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I am old and frail?’

9.t: He said, ‘This is what your Lord has said: “It is easy for Me: I created you, though you were nothing before.” ’

10.t: He said, ‘Give me a sign, Lord.’ He said, ‘Your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to anyone for three full [days and] nights.’

11.t: He went out of the sanctuary to his people and signalled to them to praise God morning and evening.

12.t: [We said], ‘John, hold on to the Scripture firmly.’ While he was still a boy, We granted him wisdom,

13.t: tenderness from Us, and purity. He was devout,

14.t: kind to his parents, not domineering or rebellious.

15.t: Peace was on him the day he was born, the day he died, and it will be on him the day he is raised to life again.

16.t: Mention in the Quran the story of Mary. She withdrew from her family to a place to the east

17.t: and secluded herself away; We sent Our Spirit to appear before her in the form of a perfected man.

18.t: She said, ‘I seek the Lord of Mercy’s protection against you: if you have any fear of Him [do not approach]!’

19.t: but he said, ‘I am but a Mes-senger from your Lord, [come] to announce to you the gift of a pure son.’

20.t: She said, ‘How can I have a son when no man has touched me? I have not been unchaste,’

21.t: and he said, ‘This is what your Lord said: “It is easy for Me- We shall make him a sign to all people, a blessing from Us.”’

22.t: And so it was ordained: she conceived him. She withdrew to a distant place

23.t: and, when the pains of childbirth drove her to [cling to] the trunk of a palm tree, she exclaimed, ‘I wish I had been dead and forgotten long before all this!’

24.t: but a voice cried to her from below, ‘Do not worry: your Lord has provided a stream at your feet

25.t: and, if you shake the trunk of the palm tree towards you, it will deliver fresh ripe dates for you,

26.t: so eat, drink, be glad, and say to anyone you may see: “I have vowed to the Lord of Mercy to abstain from conversation, and I will not talk to anyone today.”’

27.t: She went back to her people carrying the child, and they said, ‘Mary! You have done something terrible!

28.t: Sister of Aaron! Your father was not an evil man; your mother was not unchaste!’

29.t: She pointed at him. They said, ‘How can we converse with an infant?’

30.t: [But] he said: ‘I am a servant of God. He has granted me the Scripture; made me a prophet;

31.t: made me blessed wherever I may be. He commanded me to pray, to give alms as long as I live,

32.t: to cherish my mother. He did not make me domineering or graceless.

33.t: Peace was on me the day I was born, and will be on me the day I die and the day I am raised to life again.’

34.t: Such was Jesus, son of Mary. [This is] a statement of the Truth about which they are in doubt:

35.t: it would not befit God to have a child. He is far above that: when He decrees something, He says only, ‘Be,’ and it is.

36.t: ‘God is my Lord and your Lord, so serve Him: that is a straight path.’

37.t: But factions have differed among themselves. What suffering will come to those who obscure the truth when a dreadful Day arrives!

38.t: How sharp of hearing, how sharp of sight they will be when they come to Us, although now they are clearly off course! Warn them [Muhammad] of the Day of Remorse when the matter will be decided,

39.t: for they are heedless and do not believe.

40.t: It is We who will inherit the earth and all who are on it: they will all be returned to Us.

41.t: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Abraham. He was a man of truth, a prophet.

42.t: He said to his father, ‘Father, why do you worship something that can neither hear nor see nor benefit you in any way?

43.t: Father, knowledge that has not reached you has come to me, so follow me: I will guide you to an even path.

44.t: Father, do not worship Satan- Satan has rebelled against the Lord of Mercy.

45.t: Father, I fear that a punishment from the Lord of Mercy may afflict you and that you may become Satan’s companion [in Hell].’

46.t: His father answered, ‘Abraham, do you reject my gods? I will stone you if you do not stop this. Keep out of my way!’

47.t: Abraham said, ‘Peace be with you: I will beg my Lord to forgive you- He is always gracious to me-

48.t: but for now I will leave you, and the idols you all pray to, and I will pray to my Lord and trust that my prayer will not be in vain.’

49.t: When he left his people and those they served beside God, We granted him Isaac and Jacob and made them both prophets:

50.t: We granted Our grace to all of them, and gave them a noble reputation.

51.t: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Moses. He was specially chosen, a messenger and a prophet:

52.t: We called to him from the right-hand side of the mountain and brought him close to Us in secret communion;

53.t: out of Our grace We granted him his brother Aaron as a prophet.

54.t: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Ishmael. He was true to his promise, a messenger and a prophet.

55.t: He commanded his household to pray and give alms, and his Lord was well pleased with him.

56.t: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Idris. He was a man of truth, a prophet.

57.t: We raised him to a high position.

58.t: These were the prophets God blessed- from the seed of Adam, of those We carried in the Ark with Noah, from the seed of Abraham and Israel- and those We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Lord of Mercy were recited to them, they fell to their knees and wept,

59.t: but there came after them generations who neglected prayer and were driven by their own desires. These will come face to face with their evil,

60.t: but those who repent, who believe, who do righteous deeds, will enter Paradise. They will not be wronged in the least:

61.t: they will enter the Gardens of Lasting Bliss, promised by the Lord of Mercy to His servants- it is not yet seen but truly His promise will be fulfilled.

62.t: There they will hear only peaceful talk, nothing bad; there they will be given provision morning and evening.

63.t: That is the Garden We shall give as their own to those of Our servants who were devout.

64.t: [Gabriel said],‘We only descend [with revelation] at your Lord’s command––everything before us, everything behind us, everything in between, all belongs to Him––your Lord is never forgetful.

65.t: He is Lord of the heavens and earth and everything in between so worship Him: be steadfast in worshipping Him. Do you know of anyone equal to Him?’

66.t: Man says, ‘What? Once I am dead, will I be brought back to life?’

67.t: but does man not remember that We created him when he was nothing before?

68.t: By your Lord [Prophet] We shall gather them and the devils together and set them on their knees around Hell;

69.t: We shall seize out of each group those who were most disobedient towards the Lord of Mercy-

70.t: We know best who most deserves to burn in Hell-

71.t: but every single one of you will approach it, a decree from your Lord which must be fulfilled.

72.t: We shall save the devout and leave the evildoers there on their knees.

73.t: When Our revelations are recited to them in all their clarity, [all that] the disbelievers say to the believers [is], ‘Which side is better situated? Which side has the better following?’

74.t: We have destroyed many a generation before them who surpassed them in riches and outward glitter!

75.t: Say [Prophet], ‘The Lord of Mercy lengthens [the lives] of the misguided, until, when they are confronted with what they have been warned about- either the punishment [in this life] or the Hour [of Judgement]- they realize who is worse situated and who has the weakest forces.’

76.t: But God gives more guidance to those who are guided, and good deeds of lasting merit are best and most rewarding in your Lord’s sight.

77.t: Have you considered the man who rejects Our revelation, who says, ‘I will certainly be given wealth and children’?

78.t: Has he penetrated the unknown or received a pledge to that effect from the Lord of Mercy?

79.t: No! We shall certainly record what he says and prolong his punishment:

80.t: We shall inherit from him all that he speaks of and he will come to Us all alone.

81.t: They have taken other gods beside God to give them strength,

82.t: but these gods will reject their worship and will even turn against them.

83.t: Have you [Prophet] not seen how We send devils to incite the disbelievers to sin?

84.t: There is no need for you to be impatient concerning them: We are counting down their [allotted] time.

85.t: On the Day We gather the righteous as an honoured company before the Lord of Mercy

86.t: and drive the sinful like a thirsty herd into Hell,

87.t: no one will have power to intercede except for those who have permission from the Lord of Mercy.

88.t: The disbelievers say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has offspring.’

89.t: How terrible is this thing you assert:

90.t: it almost causes the heavens to be torn apart, the earth to split asunder, the mountains to crumble to pieces,

91.t: that they attribute offspring to the Lord of Mercy.

92.t: It does not befit the Lord of Mercy [to have offspring]:

93.t: there is no one in the heavens or earth who will not come to the Lord of Mercy as a servant-

94.t: He has counted them all: He has numbered them exactly-

95.t: and they will each return to Him on the Day of Resurrection all alone.

96.t: But the Lord of Mercy will give love to those who believe and do righteous deeds:

97.t: We have made it easy, in your own language [Prophet], so that you may bring glad news to the righteous and warnings to a stubborn people.

98.t: How many generations We have destroyed before them! Do you perceive a single one of them now, or hear as much as a whisper?
